canonical_fields.effect_description_eng: [Main] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) Then, by returning 3 cards with the [D-Brigade] or [DigiPolice] trait from your trash to the top of the deck, delete up to 6 play cost's total worth of your opponent's Digimon.
